description: Find finished events by team name across all leagues, optionally for one sport. Date span max 31 days (default: the last 31 days). Returns up to 100 events, newest first. Use the ids with get_historical_odds.

fields.description: Optional comma-separated top-level fields to keep on each item (e.g. 'id,home,away,date,status'). Trims large responses.

maxResults.description: Optional cap on the number of items returned to you (applied after the API call).

to.description: End date in RFC3339 format, at most 31 days after from

name: search_historical_events
title: Search historical events
